calculationContract.customsValue: goods_value + freight_and_insurance_to_EU_border, using actual customs valuation treatment
calculationContract.importVat: confirmed_import_vat_base * applicable_vat_rate; recoverability must be recorded separately
calculationContract.cashLandedCostPerSet: (goods + international_freight + insurance + customs_duty + import_vat_cash + brokerage + destination_handling + domestic_transport + compliance/labeling costs) / sellable_sets
calculationContract.netEconomicLandedCostPerSet: cash_landed_cost_per_set minus only VAT amounts demonstrably recoverable under the importer actual VAT treatment
calculationContract.profitPerSet: net_sell_revenue_ex_vat - net_economic_landed_cost - marketplace_fees - fulfillment - ads_reserve - returns_reserve - other_reserves
calculationContract.breakEvenSellPrice: solve sell price where profit_per_set = 0 using the confirmed fee/reserve structure
